observations.command: echo ADUNIT; systemctl cat adagent-service.service; systemctl show adagent-service.service -p RequiredBy -p WantedBy -p Triggers -p TriggeredBy -p MainPID -p ActiveState; echo MANIFESTS; for p in com.samsung.tizen.samsung-analytics com.samsung.tv.acr-service-app com.samsung.tv.coba.adagent com.samsung.tv.iacr; do echo PACKAGE:$p; cat /opt/usr/apps/$p/tizen-manifest.xml; ls -ld /opt/usr/apps/$p; ls /opt/usr/apps/$p/bin /opt/usr/apps/$p/res 2>/dev/null; done; echo DBPATHS; ls -l /opt/dbspace/*pkg* /opt/dbspace/*app* 2>/dev/null; echo APPSTATUS; app_launcher --status; echo PROCESSPATHS; for p in 615 1468 5043; do readlink /proc/$p/exe; done; true

ADUNIT
# /usr/lib/systemd/system/adagent-service.service
[Unit]
Description=Start adagent-service Daemon
ConditionPathExists=!/opt/usr/share/systemd/system/pisa-service
DefaultDependencies=no

[Service]
User=owner
Group=users
SupplementaryGroups=system_share
Type=simple
Environment=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.pisa-service/lib
ExecStart=/opt/usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.pisa-service/bin/adagent-service
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
#CPUSchedulingPolicy=other

[Install]
WantedBy=basic.target
MainPID=615
RequiredBy=
WantedBy=basic.target
Triggers=
TriggeredBy=
ActiveState=active
